# Claude Agent SDK 0.3.293 package and native identity

This immutable fixture freezes the official npm package `0.3.284` baseline and every published successor through `0.3.293`, including the coupled embedded native manifests. Wrapper tarballs were checked against npm integrity values; no package or native artifact was executed. The current Darwin arm64 platform package was downloaded and its binary digest matches the `0.3.293` wrapper manifest.

`dist-inventory.json` records a deterministic complete package tree for every point and exact adjacent-hop path sets and hashes. `protocol.json` classifies the selected route surface and every release hop. `identity.json` records the official channel, publication times, wrapper and platform identities, native manifests and segment decision.

The qualification extends the package/native segment from baseline `0.3.284` / `2.1.284` through `0.3.293` / `2.1.293`. Node, wire, sidecar source, behavior revision, claim ids, released consumers, and exact `0.3.259` / `2.1.259` live registered-tool evidence remain separate.
